question: Sangphao tribal dance is performed in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sangphao** is a** traditional dance form** performed by the **Nagas,** an indigenous tribe of Nagaland.
 
• The dance is usually performed during** festivals and special occasions**, and is known for its** energetic and lively movements.**
 
• Sangphao is also accompanied by **traditional music **played on instruments such as the **log drum, bamboo flute, and gong.**
 
• **Option 4**, Nagaland, is the** correct answer** to the question as Sangphao is exclusively performed by the **Nagas of Nagaland.**
 
• **Gujarat, Rajasthan, and West Bengal **do have their own traditional dance forms, but Sangphao is not one of them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gujarat **is known for its **Garba dance, **which is performed during the **Navratri festival.**
 
• **Rajasthan** has several traditional dance forms such as **Ghoomar, Kalbelia, and Chari**, which are performed during **festivals and weddings.**
 
• **West Bengal** is known for its classical dance form,** Kathak**, as well as its folk dances such as** Baul, Chau, and Santhal.**
 
• **Nagaland i**s a **northeastern state** of India, known for its rich cultural heritage and diverse indigenous **tribes**. 
 
• **Sangphao** is just one of the many traditional dance forms of Nagaland.
